entries.def:
φανερῶς
adv. (φανερός), [in LXX: 2Ma.3.28 * ;] 
__(a) manifestly, openly: Mrk.1.45 opposite to ἐν κρυπτῷ„ Jhn.7.10 
__(b) clearly: Act.10.3 (2Ma.3.28).†
(AS)

φανέρωσις, -εως, ἡ
(φανερόω), [in LXX as seel. for δήλωσις אוּרִים), Lev.8.8, Cod. Ven. (Thayer, see word) * ;] 
manifestation: 1Co.12.7, 2Co.4.2.†
(AS)

φανός, -οῦ, ὁ
(φαίνω), 
a torch or lantern (see Rutherford, NPhr., 131 f.): Jhn.18.3.†
SYN.: see: λαμπάς (AS)

Φανουήλ, ὁ indecl. (Heb. פְּנוּאֵל), 
Phanuel: Luk.2.36.†
(AS)

φαντάζω
(φαίνω) [in LXX: Wis.6.16, Sir.31.5 (34:5)* ;] 
to make visible. In cl. used in pass. only, = φαίνομαι, to become visible, appear: ptcp., Heb.12.21.†
(AS)

φαντασία, -ας, ἡ
(φαντάζω), [in LXX: Zec.10.1 (חֲזִיז), חֲזִיז), Hab.2.18-19; 3.10, Wis.18.17 * ;] 
__1. as philos. term, 
__(a) imagination; 
__(b) = φάντασμα (Plat., Arist.). 
__2. In later writers (Polyb., al.), show, display: Act.25.23.†
(AS)

φάντασμα, -τος, τό
(φαντάζω), [in LXX: Job.20.8 A (חִזָּיוֹן), Isa.28.7 A, Wis.17.15 * ;] 
= φάσμα, an appearance, apparition (Æsch., al.): Mat.14.26, Mrk.6.49 (see DCG, i, 111b).†
(AS)

φάραγξ, -αγγος, ἡ 
[in LXX chiefly for נַחַל, also for גַּיְא, etc. ;] 
a chasm, ravine: Luk.3.5 (LXX) (see DB, iv, 845 f.).†
(AS)

Φαραώ, ὁ indecl. 
(in FlJ, Ant., viii, 6, 2, Φαραών, -ῶνος), (Heb. פַּרְעֹה), 
Pharaoh, the general title of the kings of Egypt: Act.7.13, 21, Rom.9.17, Heb.11.24; Φ. βασιλεὺς Αἰγύπτου, Act.7.10.†
(AS)
